Publish.LongDescription:
# Beta Test Driving Mod
Beta Test Driving Mod lets you possess and drive a real live vehicle already moving in Cities: Skylines II. This update keeps the tested Direct Drive system, the cleaner top-left COUI driving panel, safer crashguard paths around control/camera cleanup, the tested GTA-style attached chase camera, and unlocked manual tuning values. The public UI now hides advanced assist and experimental chase controls so players cannot accidentally break the safe driving setup.
Feedback / bug reports: https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/beta-test-driving-mod-feedback-and-bug-reports.1925686/
Source / MIT license: https://github.com/northernst11-bot/BetaTestDrivingMod
The source code and original project assets are open source under the MIT License. Everyone may use, copy, modify, fork, build, publish, distribute, sublicense, sell, and make improved variants or replacement versions from this mod, as long as the MIT copyright and license notice stay with substantial copies.
The MIT license does not grant rights to Cities: Skylines II, Paradox or Colossal Order trademarks, game assets, or third-party content not owned by this project.
Police chase note: the experimental chase controls are hidden and disabled in this public build while they keep being tested locally.
## Features
- Possess/release a real live vehicle with V - Arrow-key driving controls, recommended if WASD moves your camera or screen - WASD also works as a fallback - Top-left driving panel for speed, input status, possession, and tuning sliders - Tuning fields apply typed numbers on Enter or when leaving the field - Manual tuning values are no longer capped by the old speed, steering, response, road attach, or camera ranges - UI-safe panel layout that avoids unsupported display styles in the Cities: Skylines II UI runtime - F8 also opens or closes the driving panel - F7 toggles the attached behind-car chase camera - Camera distance, height, and look-ahead tuning sliders in the panel - Advanced assist toggles are hidden from the public UI and forced to safe defaults - Experimental police chase controls are hidden and disabled in the public build - Crashguard safety around possession/control, path-freeze, and chase camera restore - Lane-object cleanup on release so traffic is less likely to remember the possessed car at an old location - Frame-buffered keyboard input with latched quick taps - Direct physical vehicle movement after the game's normal car movement step - Vanilla physical path driving is frozen for the possessed car so AI movement does not fight player control - Road-height assist keeps the car attached to nearby road lanes with the tested no-hover behavior - Road intent assist queues AI left/right path intent from steering input without forcing the physical body to turn itself - Lane object presence sync so other traffic reacts to the possessed car's current lane position - Nearby road-lane search instead of expensive whole-city scanning - Brake-first reverse behavior: hold Down/S to stop, release and press again to reverse
## Notes
This is a beta test mod. It controls one possessed live road car and does not replace the whole traffic system. The older bus/train/watercraft experimental controls and expensive junction override are not active in this public direct-drive build.
Publish.ChangeLog: 0.3.16-public-ui-safe update: - Hides advanced road intent, road attach, AI body path, chase camera, and police chase toggles from the public driving panel. - Forces hidden advanced controls back to safe defaults so old changed values do not keep running in the background. - Keeps the top driving controls and the tuning tab available.
